```{r}
#| include: false
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")
library("ggrepel")

col_male   <- "#4F9FC4"
col_female <- "#E0787F"
col_before <- "#E0787F"
col_after  <- "#4F9FC4"
bg         <- "#002b36"

theme_moon <- function(base_size = 14) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = bg, color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = bg, color = NA),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#0f4552", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      text       = element_text(color = "#93a1a1"),
      axis.text  = element_text(color = "#93a1a1"),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#93a1a1"),
      plot.title = element_text(color = "#eee8d5", face = "bold",
                                size = base_size + 2),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```

## Background {.center style="text-align: center;"}

**Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML)** is a cancer of the myeloid cells that causes an overproduction of abnormal blast cells that crowd bone marrow and prevent it from making normal blood cells

### Research question

Which genes show differences in expression between male and female AML patients?

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Dataset and Data Wrangling {.center style="text-align: center;"}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="40%"}
TCGA-LAML gene expression data and clinical metadata

60660 gene identifiers

151 samples (84 males, 67 females)
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center
raw_metadata <- read_rds("../data/_raw/laml_metadata.rds")

processed_metadata <- read_tsv("../data/02_dat_clean_meta.tsv.gz")

# Summary table with metadata record counts
sample_summary <- tibble(
  stage = c("Before matching", "After matching"),
  records = c(nrow(raw_metadata),
              nrow(processed_metadata))
) |>
  mutate(stage = fct_inorder(stage))

# Metadata records before and after matching
ggplot(sample_summary,
       aes(x = stage, y = records, fill = stage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = records),
            vjust = -0.6, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "#eee8d5") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Before matching" = col_before,
                               "After matching" = col_after)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "Metadata records before and after matching",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of metadata records") +
  theme_moon()
```
:::
:::::

## Patient Characteristics {.center style="text-align: center;"}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center
p1 <- ggplot(processed_metadata,
             aes(x = gender.demographic, fill = gender.demographic)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)),
            vjust = -0.6, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "#eee8d5") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("male" = col_male, "female" = col_female)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("male", "female"), labels = c("Male", "Female")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "Gender distribution", x = NULL, y = "Number of patients") +
  theme_moon()

p2 <- ggplot(processed_metadata,
             aes(x = gender.demographic, y = age_at_index.demographic,
                 fill = gender.demographic, color = gender.demographic)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.9,

  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +

  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(20, 90, 10),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
  labs(title = "Age by gender", x = NULL, y = "Age (years)") +
  theme_moon()

p1 + p2 &
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = bg, color = NA))
```

## Gene Expression Distribution {.center style="text-align: center;"}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="60%"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 4.8
#| out-width: "100%"
processed_expression <- read_tsv("../data/02_dat_clean_expr.tsv.gz")

sample_expression <- processed_expression |>
  filter(!is.na(gender.demographic)) |>
  group_by(sample, gender.demographic) |>
  summarise(median_expression = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(sample_expression,
       aes(x = median_expression,
           fill = gender.demographic,
           color = gender.demographic)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("male" = col_male, "female" = col_female),
                    breaks = c("male", "female"),
                    labels = c("Male", "Female")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("male" = col_male, "female" = col_female),
                     breaks = c("male", "female"),
                     labels = c("Male", "Female")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of median gene expression",
       subtitle = "Sample-level median across all genes by gender",
       x = "Median expression (log2 CPM)",
       y = "Density",
       fill = "Gender",
       color = "Gender") +
  theme_moon(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
:::

::: {.column width="40%" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.6em; line-height: 1.35;"}
**Global baseline:** sample medians overlap closely between genders

**Shape:** both groups are bimodal

**Limit:** similar medians do not rule out single-gene differences
:::
:::::

## Highly Variable Genes {.center style="text-align: center;"}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 3.3
#| out-width: "100%"
top_50_genes <- processed_expression |>
  group_by(Ensembl_ID) |>
  summarise(variance = var(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(variance)) |>
  slice_head(n = 50)

top_50_clean <- sub("\\..*$", "", top_50_genes$Ensembl_ID)

gender_heatmap_horiz <- processed_expression |>
  filter(Ensembl_ID %in% top_50_genes$Ensembl_ID,
         !is.na(gender.demographic)) |>
  group_by(Ensembl_ID) |>
  mutate(expression_scaled = (expression - mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE)) /
           sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(Ensembl_ID, gender.demographic) |>
  summarise(mean_scaled_expression = mean(expression_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(gene_label = sub("\\..*$", "", as.character(Ensembl_ID)),
         gene_label = factor(gene_label, levels = top_50_clean))

ggplot(gender_heatmap_horiz,
       aes(x = gene_label,
           y = gender.demographic,
           fill = mean_scaled_expression)) +
  geom_tile(color = bg, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4F9FC4",
                       mid = "#073642",
                       high = "#E0787F",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       name = "Mean scaled\nexpression") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = c("female", "male"),
                   labels = c("Female", "Male"),
                   expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Highly variable gene expression in TCGA-LAML",
       subtitle = "Top 50 most variable genes (ordered left to right by variance): mean z-score by gender",
       x = NULL,
       y = NULL) +
  theme_moon(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5, family = "mono", angle = 90,
                                   vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold",
                                   color = "#eee8d5"),
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 12, barheight = 0.6))
```

**Color scale:** Mean gene-wise z-score (blue = lower, coral = higher).

**Main pattern:** Top variable genes show group contrasts (e.g., sex-linked transcripts).

**Exploratory limit:** Ranked by total variance, not formal differential expression tests.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Linear Models Approach {.center style="text-align: center;"}

-   One model per gene: **expression \~ gender + age**
-   Gender coefficient = **log2FC** male vs female
-   FDR correction
-   Significant: **q \< 0.05** and **\|log2FC\| \> 1**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Linear Models Result {.center style="text-align: center;"}

```{r}
#| include: false
lm_results <- read_tsv("../data/05_dat_lm_results.tsv.gz")

n_changed <- lm_results |>
  filter(direction != "NS") |>
  nrow()
n_changed_sex <- lm_results |>
  filter(direction != "NS", sex_chrom) |>
  nrow()
```

::::: columns
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| out-width: "100%"
volcano_dat <- lm_results |>
  mutate(gene_group = case_when(direction == "NS" ~ "Not significant",
                                sex_chrom ~ "X/Y",
                                TRUE ~ "Autosomal"),
         label = if_else(direction != "NS",
                         coalesce(symbol, gene),
                         ""))

volcano_dat |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate,
             y = -log10(pmax(q_value, 1e-300)),
             colour = gene_group,
             label = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#586e75") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#586e75") +
  geom_text_repel(data = volcano_dat |>
                    filter(label != ""),
                  size = 3, colour = "#eee8d5",
                  max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Not significant" = "#586e75",
                                 "X/Y" = "#E0787F",
                                 "Autosomal" = "#4F9FC4")) +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change (male vs female)",
       y = "-log10(q value)",
       colour = NULL,
       title = "Male vs female, 151 AML patients") +
  theme_moon() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
:::

::: {.column width="35%" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.6em; line-height: 1.35;"}
**`r n_changed` genes** significant, **`r n_changed_sex`** on X/Y

XIST ↑ in females, Y genes ↑ in males → **sanity check**

Autosomal hits: mostly pseudogenes (**mapping artefact**)
:::
:::::

## Over-Representation Analysis {.center style="text-align: center;"}

```{r}
#| include: false
ora_pathways <- read_tsv("../data/07_dat_ora_pathways.tsv")
ora_genes <- read_tsv("../data/07_dat_ora_genes.tsv")
```

::: {style="font-size: 0.6em; color: #93a1a1; margin-bottom: 0.4em;"}
**Goal:** identify biological processes over-represented among differentially expressed genes
:::

:::::::: columns
::: {.column width="33%" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.75em;"}
[**1. Define DEGs and background**]{style="color: #eee8d5;"}

```{.r code-line-numbers="false"}
deg_genes <- lm_results |>
  filter(q_value < 0.05) |>
  pull(gene_id) |>
  unique()

background_genes <- lm_results |>
  pull(gene_id) |>
  unique()
```

[53 DEGs out of 20,416 tested genes]{style="font-size: 0.8em;"}
:::

::: {.column width="33%" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.75em;"}
[**2. Retrieve GO Biological Processes**]{style="color: #eee8d5;"}

```{.r code-line-numbers="false"}
bp_df <- msigdbr(
  species = "human",
  category = "C5",
  subcategory = "GO:BP"
)
```

[Gene Ontology Biological Process gene sets]{style="font-size: 0.8em;"}
:::

::: {.column width="33%" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.75em;"}
[**3. Test for enrichment**]{style="color: #eee8d5;"}

```{.r code-line-numbers="false"}
fisher.test(
  matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2),
  alternative = "greater"
)
```

[Fisher's exact test + Benjamini–Hochberg correction (FDR < 0.05)]{style="font-size: 0.8em;"}
:::

## Enriched Biological Processes {.center style="text-align: center;"}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| out-width: "100%"
ora_pathways |>
  mutate(pathway = str_remove(gs_name, "^GOBP_"),
         pathway = str_replace_all(pathway, "_", " "),
         pathway = str_wrap(str_to_sentence(pathway), 20),
         pathway = fct_reorder(pathway, -log10(q_value))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(q_value), y = pathway)) +
  geom_col(fill = col_after, width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#586e75") +
  geom_text(aes(label = signif(q_value, 2)),
            hjust = -0.2, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = "#eee8d5") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(title = "Enriched GO Biological Processes",
       x = "-log10(q value)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_moon() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#eee8d5"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#0f4552",
                                          linewidth = 0.4),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| out-width: "100%"
ora_genes |>
  mutate(symbol = fct_reorder(symbol, estimate),
         chrom = str_remove(chrom, "chr")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = symbol, fill = chrom)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#586e75") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(estimate, 1),
                hjust = if_else(estimate > 0, -0.2, 1.2)),
            size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = "#eee8d5") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("X" = col_female, "Y" = col_male),
                    labels = c("X" = "chrX", "Y" = "chrY")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  labs(title = "Genes driving the enrichment",
       x = "log2 fold change (male vs female)",
       y = NULL,
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_moon() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#eee8d5", face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#0f4552",
                                          linewidth = 0.4),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
:::
:::::

::: {style="font-size: 0.6em;"}
The enrichment in **demethylation**-related processes is driven by four genes on the sex chromosomes: [KDM5C]{style="color: #E0787F; font-weight: bold;"} and [KDM6A]{style="color: #E0787F; font-weight: bold;"} (X), [KDM5D]{style="color: #4F9FC4; font-weight: bold;"} and [UTY]{style="color: #4F9FC4; font-weight: bold;"} (Y)
:::


------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Conclusions and Limitations {.center style="text-align: center;"}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.7em;"}
**Conclusions**

-   Sex differences almost **only on X and Y**
-   PCA: sex and age are not the main variation
-   ORA: enrichment driven by **X–Y gene pairs**
:::

::: {.column width="50%" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.7em;"}
**Limitations**

-   No mutation data → no subgroup analysis
-   Linear models, not count-based (DESeq2)
-   ORA gives no direction of change
:::
:::::
